info.title: OpenMapX API
info.description: Generated from the API's own route table and the integration route registry. Do not edit by hand — run `pnpm openapi:generate`.

tags.name: activity-admin
tags.description: Activity administration: application and data-manager jobs, cancellation and live application events.

tags.name: admin
tags.description: Operator-facing administration of integrations, services, settings and jobs.

tags.name: auth
tags.description: Authentication and OAuth endpoints served by Better Auth.

tags.name: data-manager-admin
tags.description: Data-manager administration, transit maintenance and ambient publications.

tags.name: integration-admin
tags.description: Integration, credential, binding and overview administration with validated contracts.

tags.name: internal
tags.description: Endpoints for other OpenMapX processes, not for clients.

tags.name: meta
tags.description: Process-level endpoints: health and registry dumps.

tags.name: runtime-metadata
tags.description: Public runtime capabilities, integration metadata and legal disclosures.
